exposure: Adherence to WHO safe surgery checklist protocols (pre-operative, intra-operative, post-operative)
outcome: Adherence rates to pre-operative protocols (team handovers, patient bathing)
Adherence rates to intra-operative practices (chlorhexidine for skin prep, thromboprophylaxis, incision type, hysterotomy site)
cohort: The study participants were medical practitioners involved in Cesarean deliveries across Rwanda.
finding: Significant gaps were found in adherence to pre-operative protocols, specifically team handovers and patient bathing, and deficiencies in intra-operative thromboprophylaxis measures among medical practitioners in Rwanda, with adherence influenced by job title and clinical experience.
